doc.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recordings and V-Discs with the Dorsey band
summary: They discuss how many records he made with Dorsey and the V-Discs with the Dorsey trio.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You made and awful lot of recordings with him.
Almost. How many do you think?
Oh, I can’t even imagine, but not twenty, I don’t think…
But we did a lot of, for instance, we did a lot of…
[laughter] I’m serious, I think I’ve counted in the discography, I think it was nineteen…
I mean if your discography is accurate.

I didn’t think so. Well, I know that we did a lot of those V-Discs. They used to, the ones for the Armed Services, they were calling them V-Discs. They were broadcasted and recorded, and we did many of those. A lot of those with just Dodo Marmaroso and Gene Krupa and myself, the trio in the Dorsey band.
